public.agency.draft_description: An insurance agency branch/office that employs agents; agents under an agency write policies.

public.agent.draft_description: An insurance agent who writes (sells) policies on behalf of an agency. is_active=false means no longer employed.

public.beneficiary.draft_description: Person who receives payout under a policy (mainly Life policies). allocation_pct is the share of payout, should sum to 100 across a policy's beneficiaries.

public.claim.draft_description: A claim filed by a policyholder against their policy after an incident. status moves open -> under_review -> approved/denied -> closed. paid_amount is null until a payout is made.

public.claim_status_history.draft_description: Audit trail of every status change a claim went through, with who changed it and when.

public.communication_log.draft_description: Record of outbound communication (email/sms/phone/mail) sent to a customer, optionally about a specific policy.

public.coverage.draft_description: A named type of protection (e.g. Collision, Liability, Fire, Theft, Flood) that can be attached to a policy via policy_coverage.

public.customer.draft_description: A person who holds one or more insurance policies. The root entity for the customer domain.

public.document.draft_description: A file attached to either a policy or a claim (exactly one of policy_id/claim_id is set, never both) — e.g. policy PDFs, claim photos, police reports.

public.payment_method.draft_description: A stored payment method (credit card, ACH, check) a customer uses to pay policy premiums. is_default marks the one used unless overridden.

public.policy.draft_description: An insurance policy contract, the central entity of the schema. status is one of active/lapsed/cancelled/expired — 'lapsed' specifically means the premium went unpaid past the grace period (see premium_payment.status='missed'); 'cancelled' means the customer or company terminated it early; 'expired' means the term ended and it was not renewed. annual_premium is the yearly written premium amount.

public.policy_coverage.draft_description: Join table linking a policy to the coverages attached to it, with the coverage_limit and deductible negotiated for that policy.

public.policy_holder.draft_description: Links a customer to the role of holding a policy (a customer becomes a policy_holder in order to be issued a policy); supports co-holders via relationship_to_customer/is_primary, though this synthetic dataset only has primary holders.

public.policy_type.draft_description: Category of insurance product: Auto, Home, Life, or Umbrella. Determines which related asset table (vehicle/property) and coverages typically apply.

public.premium_payment.draft_description: A scheduled premium payment (the 'written premium' installment) for a policy. status is pending/paid/late/missed. Two or more consecutive 'missed' payments on a policy is what drives it to policy.status='lapsed' in this dataset.

public.property.draft_description: The real-estate property insured under a Home policy (one row per Home policy). replacement_value is the insured value used for coverage limits.

public.underwriting_decision.draft_description: The risk-assessment outcome recorded when a policy was issued (decision: approved/denied/referred, plus a numeric risk_score — higher means riskier).

public.vehicle.draft_description: The vehicle insured under an Auto policy (one row per Auto policy).
